title: StrategyX
tagline: A yield strategy marketplace enabling users to discover and auto-compound returns through expert-curated DeFi positions. Compare live yields, track performance metrics, and automatically deploy capital across proven strategies.
description:
Our platform connects DeFi traders who create successful yield strategies with users looking to earn better returns on their crypto.

What makes us different?
- Traders can create and share their strategies without writing code
- Our platform automatically turns these strategies into smart contracts
- Users can view each strategy's real performance and risk level
- One click to invest in any strategy
- Automatic compounding of returns
- Everything managed from a single dashboard

For Traders:
- Create strategies using our simple tools
- Earn fees when users invest in your strategies
- Track how your strategies perform
- Build a reputation with verified results

For Users:
- Find strategies that match your goals
- See actual returns before investing
- Start with any amount
- Automatic reinvestment of earnings
- Easy to withdraw anytime
- No technical knowledge needed

We're fixing the current problems with copy-trading in DeFi:
- No more following trades manually
- No need to watch multiple platforms
- No complicated setup process
- Clear performance tracking

Our goal is simple: make it easy for anyone to earn yields in DeFi by following expert strategies, while rewarding the traders who create successful strategies.
how_its_made:
Technical Architecture:

Frontend:
- Built with Next.js 14 and Tailwind CSS for a responsive, modern interface
- Real-time performance metrics and strategy visualization
- Wallet integration for seamless transactions

Smart Contract Infrastructure:
- Dedicated Node.js server for dynamic contract generation and deployment
- Strategy contracts are automatically generated based on trader inputs
- Integration with key DeFi protocols:
  * Aave for lending/borrowing operations
  * 1inch for optimal token swaps
  * Pyth Network for reliable price feeds

Backend Services:
- CurveGrid for contract indexing and event tracking
- Webhook system to monitor strategy performance and trigger alerts
- Custom indexer to track cross-protocol interactions

Our MVP currently supports basic yield strategies using Aave and 1inch, with plans to add more protocols and strategy types. The architecture is designed to be modular, making it easy to add new protocols and strategy templates.
